hook: [[LAST_VALUE]] ka trap jisme 90% log phaste hain

slides.title: Window ke [[do kinare]]
points: Jaise queue mein **pehla aur aakhri** banda

slides.title: Dept ka [[top earner]]
slides.note: Har dept alag window, salary DESC → pehla = **sabse ameer** 💰

slides.title: Ab [[trap]] dekho 🪤
points: ORDER BY lagate hi default frame:
slides.note: Frame = window ka kitna hissa dikhe. Default aadha hi hai!

slides.title: Fix: [[full frame]]
slides.code:
LAST_VALUE(name) OVER (
  PARTITION BY dept
  ORDER BY salary DESC
  ROWS BETWEEN
    UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
) AS lowest_earner
slides.note: Ab poori window dikhti hai → aakhri = **sabse kam salary**

slides.title: Bina frame vs [[full frame]]
slides.note: Shortcut: ORDER BY ulta karke **FIRST_VALUE** lo, trap hi khatam 😎

slides.wrong:
LAST_VALUE(name) OVER (
  ORDER BY salary DESC)
slides.right:
LAST_VALUE(name) OVER (
  ORDER BY salary DESC
  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED
  PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED
  FOLLOWING)
slides.why: Full frame bhoole to har row ko **apni hi value** milegi 💀

points: Default frame current row pe **rukta hai**

caption:
LAST_VALUE ka trap jisme 90% log phaste hain 🪤

FIRST_VALUE easy hai, LAST_VALUE tricky!
Is post mein:
✅ FIRST_VALUE se dept ka top earner
✅ Default window frame ka trap
✅ ROWS BETWEEN ... UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING fix
✅ Ulta ORDER BY shortcut
